title: Two sample outputs name renderer 0.3.1, and this binary renders 0.3.2
foundBy: session agent, following README.md and INSTALL.md as a first-time reader

evidence.verified: `cs-ledger version` prints renderer 0.3.2 and `cs-ledger init` prints toolVersion 0.3.2. `grep -rn '0\.3\.1' *.md` now returns nothing.

details:
INSTALL.md's `init` sample printed `toolVersion 0.3.1` and MANUAL.md's `version` sample printed `(renderer 0.3.1, ui tokens 1.12.0)`. Both are 0.3.2 now.

MANUAL.md warns that the first field of `version` is a `git describe` and will read differently per build. It then says "the renderer version is the one that matters to a ledger", which is the half that was wrong.

A third instance sat in an example commit message.
